how_drawn: named by SUPPORTED_STATE, plus transitive reachability from those, plus every script/Dart entrypoint under the bound product directories. The negative existential is claimed over the UNION, so the tiers need not be adjudicated to support it.
vendored_exclusion_reason: bin/cache holds a vendored Flutter checkout and third_party/ vendored sources; their own dynamic interfaces are not this fork's release policy. Counted so the exclusion is visible rather than silent.
